prompts.enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a premium top-down sci-fi survival shooter. Create ONE meticulously aligned 4 columns x 3 rows sprite sheet, 12 equal square cells, preferably 1536x1152. Detailed painted 3D metal, ivory-gray titanium against dark gunmetal cavities, orange-red hostile reactor lights, subtle rimlight, strongly readable distinct silhouettes. prompts.panels: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: 2D sci-fi game UI skin texture atlas, NOT a screen mockup. Each cell contains exactly one rectangular blank panel filling its entire cell with aligned edges, use crisp 24px bevelled borders suitable for nine-slice stretching, keep CENTER visually quiet and nearly uniform dark navy for Korean text overlay. No lettering, no controls or icons, no text anywhere. Premium brushed dark titanium sci-fi HUD, restrained cyan edge lights, tiny gold corner clamps. Row-major six skins: 1 dark navy graphite standard card with steel bevel; 2 selected card dark navy with brighter cyan bevel and subtle cyan corners; 3 primary action button rich teal metal center with polished cyan edges (dark enough for white text); 4 secondary action button dark slate with silver-blue edges; 5 near-black HUD panel subtly translucent looking, quiet clean thin steel border; 6 gold-accent reward/upgrade card with dark blue center. Consistent lighting from upper left, beautiful textured raster artwork.
